svg.text: STAGE 520 🎉 · TOPIC 160 🎉 · P1033 🎉–P1034 🎉 · SVG 164 · 162nd FAQ · 🎉 HISTORIC STAGE 520 & TOPIC 160 DUAL MILESTONE!
WebRTC/RTP RFC 4588 / RFC 8854 RTX Retransmission OSN Write Lock & NACK Anti-Amplification Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RFC 4588 RTX Path (Frame Overwrite & NACK Flood)
1. Unrequested RTX OSN Overwriting Clean Received Frames
RTX (OSN=501) overwrites already-received slot[501] in JB!
• Naive jitter buffer blindly replaces intact speech with forged payload
• Bloated rtx-time=4000ms injects stale ghost audio into playout
2. 16-Byte RTCP NACK (BLP=0xFFFF) 17x Bitmask Amplification
NACK (PID=100, BLP=0xFFFF) x9 repeats -> 153 RTX packets!
• Duplicate NACK bursts re-trigger identical retransmissions 9x
• Saturates shared BUNDLE send queue & starves live 20ms Opus audio
3. Unbounded 85% RTX-to-Media Bandwidth Ratio Collapse
RTX consumes 680 kbps of 800 kbps link budget (85%!)
• Retransmitting old packets chokes out fresh voice frames
• Causes cascading congestion spiral on mobile links
✅ Deterministic RFC 4588 Guardrails (P1033 🎉 + P1034 🎉)
P1033 🎉 (Stage 520 & Topic 160!): OSN Write Lock & [100, 1000]ms
action: "reject_unrequested_rtx_osn_overwrite_and_clamp_rtx_time_ms"
• Admits RTX OSN only into verified MISSING slots (write-once lock)
• clampedSpoofedRtxOsnFrameOverwrites = 0 (zero frame poisoning)
• clampedRtxBufferRetentionWindowMs in [100, 1000]ms
Policy: P1033-WEBRTC-RFC4588-RTX-OSN-CACHE-OVERWRITE-AND-APT-BINDING-GUARD
P1034 🎉 (1,043rd Guardrail!): [1, 2] Retries & [10, 25]% RTX Cap
action: "cap_nack_retries_per_packet_and_clamp_rtx_bandwidth_ratio"
• Caps retransmissions per lost sequence number to [1, 2] with RTT gate
• clampedMaxRetransmissionsPerLostPacket in [1, 2] retries
• clampedMaxRtxToMediaBitrateRatioPct in [10, 25]% (live voice first)
Policy: P1034-WEBRTC-RFC4588-NACK-RETRANSMIT-AMPLIFICATION-AND-BANDWIDTH-RATIO-GUARD
